description:
This endpoint creates or updates a batch of Cost Codes.
See [Using Sync Actions](/documentation/using-sync-actions) for additional information.

parameters.name: sub_job_id
parameters.description: ID of the sub job to scope this sync operation to. When provided, cost codes are created or updated under this sub job rather than the project directly.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Cost Code

position.description: Sort order of this cost code within its parent.

code.description: Cost code segment, not including the parent prefix. For example, for full code "02-300", the value of this field should be "300".

name.description: Display name of the cost code.

origin_data.description: Free-form third-party metadata string from the ERP system.

origin_id.description: ERP system identifier for this cost code. Used by sync operations to match records across systems.

parent_id.description: ID of the parent cost code in the hierarchy. Creates a root-level cost code when omitted.

parent_origin_id.description: ERP origin ID of the parent cost code. Alternative to parent_id for looking up the parent by its ERP identifier rather than its Procore ID.

standard_cost_code_id.description: ID of the company-level standard cost code to associate with this cost code.
